text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser has just completed her full training regimen, when…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! I want to run for a bit longer today!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Fuku told me that my lucky item today is the moon!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I think I might get some kind of amazing power if I run at night! This is my big chance to go beyond my ordinary self!
choice_data_list: Get out there and shoot for the moon!
Sorry, but you'll end up working yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Okay! Get ready to see my moonlight powerup!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Up, up, and away I go! Ei, ei, mun! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser happily continues running well into the night.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hrm… But if the power comes from moonlight…
choice_data_list: Wouldn't just looking at the moon be enough?
Wouldn't just looking at the moon be enough?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, now that you mention it, she never said I had to run.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: In that case, I'll just gaze at the moon from my room tonight until I'm full of power!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that decided, Matikanetannhauser returns to her dorm.
